test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 4: Teacher Responds and Updates the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Answers Student Question in Forum
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged in and redirected to the Dashboard Page. A course titled 'Introduction to Software Engineering' exists and has a forum entry 'non_empty_entry_title' with content 'non_empty_entry_content' posted by a student.
test_cases.expected_result: The system successfully adds the teacher's reply to the forum entry, and the updated forum showing the reply is displayed. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher's reply is successfully added to the forum entry in the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course list item (link) on the Dashboard Page to navigate to the Course Details Page.
Click the 'Forum' tab to view forum entries.
Click the 'Reply' button next to the forum entry with the title 'non_empty_entry_title'.
Enter 'This is a helpful reply to your question.' into the 'Reply Content' text area.
Click the 'Reply' button to submit the reply.

test_data_fields.field_value: This is a helpful reply to your question.

test_cases.groups_involved: Forum Entry Actions, Create New Forum Entry, Reply to Forum Entry
